entities.name: Query biotin synthase
observations: The 353-residue sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt protein A9C2R2, annotated as biotin synthase.
The sequence contains a Radical_SAM domain at positions 83–230 and a BATS domain at positions 254–344.
The protein is annotated to bind a [4Fe–4S] cluster through three cysteines and an additional [2Fe–2S] cluster; reviewed homologs are homodimeric.

source_tools.relevance: Exact-sequence match, domains, cofactors, and subunit annotation

entities.name: Dethiobiotin to biotin
observations: Biotin synthase catalyzes sulfur insertion into (4R,5S)-dethiobiotin to form biotin through a radical SAM mechanism.

The complete annotated reaction uses a sulfur carrier, two S-adenosyl-L-methionine molecules, reduced [2Fe-2S] ferredoxin, and produces 5'-deoxyadenosine, L-methionine, oxidized ferredoxin, and biotin.
The reaction is associated with EC 2.8.1.6 and Rhea RHEA:22060.
